title: A save says which build wrote it, and keeps the list of builds the farm has lived under
tier_reason: Save and replay metadata behind the unit suite; git reverts it. Nothing in the sim changes; the risk is a stray field leaking into the canonical comparison, which the tests pin.
ask: The CEO, 2026-09-10, after the shelf showed a tablet session that no longer replays because Q-98 landed the same day: 'Do we generally have a way to annotate the game version at start and any time we resume from save?' Today: the replay log stamps build_id at start() and start_from_save() (systems/sim/replay_log.gd:99-116, from application/config/build_id which the deploy stamps from git describe), and HQ's Playtests page shows it; the autosave carries only its schema 'version' (systems/sim/save_game.gd) and no build, and nothing accumulates the builds a farm has lived under across resumes. Wanted: (1) the save's state carries build_id of the build that wrote it; (2) a JSON-plain 'lineage' list on the save — entries {build, day, tick, event: 'start'|'resume'} — appended at a new game and whenever a save is loaded under a build different from its last entry (a build cannot change mid-session, so start and resume cover it); (3) lineage and build_id are EXCLUDED from SaveGame.capture_canonical the way selected_tool is, so a replay compared against its autosave is unaffected; (4) tools/verify_replay.gd and the unit suite's shelf check print 'recorded under X, checked under Y' from these fields instead of relying on a hand-written comment; (5) HQ's Playtests page (hq/static/playtests.js, hq/server.py's playtests reader) shows the chain per session, e.g. 'started under 157, resumed under 163 on day 12'. Additive keys; no save VERSION bump; a save without them reads as unknown provenance.
first_action: Read SaveGame.capture/restore/capture_canonical and ReplayLog.start/start_from_save; add build_id and lineage to the save's state at write, the resume-append in the load path main.gd uses for Continue, and the canonical exclusion; unit tests: a new farm's lineage is one 'start' entry with the running build; a save restored under a different stamped build gains a 'resume' entry and under the same build gains none; capture_canonical is byte-identical with and without lineage; the shelf check's message names both builds. Then the Playtests page reads the chain. Both suites and the gateway check green.
source_message: CEO, 2026-09-10, asking whether the game version should be annotated at start and on every resume.
result:
HQ now preserves unknown earlier history when an old save’s first known entry is a resume. It displays “earlier build history not recorded, resumed under 163 on day 12” instead of inventing a start.

Added regression tests for that wording and the complete shelf message: “recorded under X, checked under Y.”

Checks:

- Unit tests: 2,859 passed
- Integration tests: 969 passed
- Gateway check: passed
- HQ: 26/28 files passed; only the two existing Chromium tests were blocked by sandbox socket permissions. The new HQ test passed.

prior_results.result:
Saves now record the writer build and the farm’s build lineage. New farms add a start entry; Continue adds a resume entry only after a build change. Replay comparison excludes both fields.

Replay verification and shelf output name the recorded and checking builds. HQ shows the lineage chain on Playtests.

Unit tests: 2,858 passed. Integration tests: 969 passed. Gateway check passed. HQ: 25/27 files passed; two unrelated browser tests could not start Chromium because crash reporting sockets are blocked in this environment. The changed HQ reader and JavaScript passed targeted checks.

prior_checks.summary: Save provenance and canonical exclusions landed, but HQ falsely labels the first known resume of an older save as its start, and the required shelf-message assertion is missing.

findings.what: An old save gains a first `resume` entry, but HQ renders every first entry as `started under`, inventing provenance instead of showing an unknown start.
findings.fix: Respect the entry’s event even when it is first; render a first `resume` as resumed under that build and preserve unknown earlier provenance.

findings.what: The shelf test prints the build note but never asserts that the message names both recorded and checking builds.
findings.fix: Add an assertion against a save with a known recorded build and an injected checking build, verifying the complete `recorded under X, checked under Y` message.

check.summary: Save provenance, unknown-history handling, shelf messaging, and HQ lineage display now match the requested behavior without affecting canonical replay state.
